reviews.comment: YES YES YES!!! She is the best teacher ever!!! Mrs. Hearne truly cares about her students and wants everyone to succeed. I had her for a Zoom class and she was accomodating/ understanding. Her lectures were interesting and she cared more about the overall concepts than memorizing dates. Can't recommend her enough!!!!!!

I have taken Hearne for 105 and 106 and she is an incredibly prof. Amazing with understanding that we have lives outside of her class and has a very easy curriculum. I actually didn't attend any of her classes this semester and will pass with a 95+. Her exams are very easy with detailed study sheets given prior. She deserves some kind of prize.

OMG MY FAVORITE CLASS AND MY FAVORITE PROF. Like she is SO amazing and SO caring, going to class is like talking to a big friend group and Elizabeth is like your friend. Super easy class but I learned so much from other people's stories. Highly recommend sex and sexuality in history. She is so good.

She is very kind and is also very passionate about what she teaches and why. Just go to her lectures and do the readings for her class every so often, maybe an hour once a couple'a weeks and you will get an easy A, I promise!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Class is in a discussion format where different groups talk about the articles they chose for the class to read. There are a few assignments, but most of the grade comes from leading class discussions, writing a term paper, and a short presentation. Dr. Hearne is great and willing to adjust due dates if you need an extension.

She is a wonderful professor and cares about her students! Barely any work and exams are so easy (same questions as weekly quiz). Unbiased + interesting. Class has participation. Lectures come straight from textbook so not necessary (older free versions online) unless you miss a class (posted slides don't have a ton of info)

Amazing professor! Super sweet and caring, and her class has minimal work. Never had to touch the textbook, you have exit tickets for attendance every class, and quiz once a week. Tests were fairly simple as long as you go over the suggested topics in the study guide. Would take her class again, and I'm planning to take HIST 105 with her!

Hearne is amazing, I took her for 106 and signed up for 105 with her next semester even though the time is awful, she is that good. Easy tests, I didn't take notes and haven't got below a 92 on a test. Lectures are fun, she encourages collaboration. Her attendance is an exit ticket on canvas so set a timer in case you miss class, one weekly quiz.

I absolutely LOVED having her as my professor! She is so sweet and caring, also a great teacher. Her study guides go over exactly what is needed in the exams. Her lectures are easy to understand and she is very respectful when talking about hard topics. The class is very easy to pass, so if you can, please take her class! You won't regret it :)!

Literally the sweetest woman ever. Incredibly understanding and empathetic. Class is super easy too, one quiz a week, one page paper every now and then and tests not very often. there's a required textbook but I didn't read it often. She is very kind and caring, I was sick for several days and she was incredibly helpful.
Take her I love her!! So caring about her students and really wants you to learn. Tests are relatively straightforward with minimal homework

Take this professor! Light work load, but there's an exit ticket at the end of each class to record attendance (10% of your grade). You don't have to spend much time studying. Exams are on canvas and HEAVILY based on the canvas quizzes (10 questions & 2 attempts for each quiz), so study those and pay attention in class and you'll get an A.
